name: TA-I Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TA-I Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and trades in chip resistors in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides a range of chip resistors, including current sensing components, thick film, thin film, and anti-surge and anti-sulfurization products; surface mount and assembly; high voltage, array/network, surge, and lead free products; and other electronic parts and components, as well as circuit protection products, such as fuse products.
